metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Reykjavík show higher values compared to the Snæfellsnes peninsula in 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG) - Date: 2016 (full year) - Location: Need two geometries - Reykjavík (capital city, ~64.1°N, 21.9°W) and Snæfellsnes peninsula (western Iceland, ~64.8°N, 23.5°W) 2. Masking strategy: - Nighttime lights don't need cloud masking - Use the 'avg_rad' band (average radiance) - May need to mask out areas with no data or negative values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Snæfellsnes might legitimately have very low/zero nighttime lights (rural area) - C1: If no VIIRS data for 2016 in these locations - C2: If all pixels are masked/invalid after processing - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - Compare mean values: Reykjavík should have higher nighttime lights than rural Snæfellsnes ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries const reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.9, 64.15]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around city center const snaefellsnes = ee.Geometry.Point([-23.5, 64.8]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer in peninsula // 2. Load VIIRS nighttime lights for 2016 const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31') .select('avg_rad'); // Check if collection has data const count = viirs.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS images in 2016: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { console.log("No VIIRS data for 2016"); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate mean composite for 2016 const meanImage = viirs.mean(); // 4. Calculate statistics for Reykjavík const reykjavikStats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: reykjavik, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const reykjavikMean = reykjavikStats.avg_rad_mean; const reykjavikCount = reykjavikStats.avg_rad_count; console.log(`Reykjavík - Mean: ${reykjavikMean}, Pixels: ${reykjavikCount}`); // 5. Calculate statistics for Snæfellsnes const snaefellsnesStats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: snaefellsnes, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const snaefellsnesMean = snaefellsnesStats.avg_rad_mean; const snaefellsnesCount = snaefellsnesStats.avg_rad_count; console.log(`Snæfellsnes - Mean: ${snaefellsnesMean}, Pixels: ${snaefellsnesCount}`); // 6. Validation and answer if (reykjavikCount === 0 || snaefellsnesCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in one or both regions"); console.log("C2"); return; } if (reykjavikMean === null || reykjavikMean === undefined || snaefellsnesMean === null || snaefellsnesMean === undefined || isNaN(reykjavikMean) || isNaN(snaefellsnesMean)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid results"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare values console.log(`Difference: ${(reykjavikMean - snaefellsnesMean).toFixed(4)}`); if (reykjavikMean > snaefellsnesMean) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
